name: Data Viz Studio
description: From raw CSV to a shippable dashboard: profile columns, recommend a layout, and emit a self-contained single-file HTML dashboard with zero external requests. Plus a chart-selection lexicon covering encoding priority, per-chart-type caveats, and the classic mistakes.
description_zh: 从原始 CSV 到能交付的仪表盘：列类型推断与分布摘要、布局推荐、生成零外部依赖的自包含单文件 HTML。另附图表选择词库（视觉编码优先级、各图型适用与反例、截断坐标轴等经典错误清单）。
